timeMeasurementScopeDecision.decision: Remove the inspector's manual time-entry module and all its inputs. Collect time automatically from the inspection workflow, activity context and capture events; inspectors should never be expected to fill in minutes by activity.
assistantImplementationNotes: Use activity and capture events with idle/background handling rather than assuming an open page equals active labour.

Exact idle thresholds, event attribution and reporting presentation remain later implementation decisions, not yet agreed with the user.
timeMeasurementScopeDecision.supersedes: Earlier manually entered pilot capture/review/report/reentry/support minute measurements.

qualityReviewScopeDecision.decision: Remove inspector-facing quality-review requests and the associated button/form. Administrators and quality reviewers handle oversight independently in the background, without requiring an inspector to request it.

integrationScopeDecision.vera: Within Satvey's intended scope, VERA is automatic internal synchronization of inspection status/data to the corporation's ERP and other VERA-speaking systems. It must not require a separate inspector approval or a maintenance-proposal handover workflow.
integrationScopeDecision.dico: Actual sharing of maintenance work with external chain partners belongs to a separate DICO workflow. Explicitly deferred; do not spend implementation time on that complex process in the current scope.
integrationScopeDecision.designImplication: Replace inspector-facing handover approval with unobtrusive synchronization status. Organisation integration setup belongs in settings; exceptional synchronization failures can have a contextual retry/recovery path. Exact synchronization events and payloads remain implementation-design details, not yet specified by the user.
integrationScopeDecision.supersedes: Earlier combined VERA delivery and maintenance-proposal handover design. Do not treat a future DICO workflow as a simple rename of the VERA transport.
